hero.title: From stuck
hero.lede: One-to-one coaching for new leaders and founders who know where they want to be, but not how to get there. Scroll and walk a twelve-week programme, from the first session to the top.

stages.c: A first conversation to map the ground honestly: what's working, what isn't, what you keep putting off.
We pick the summit together, and the three goals that tell you you're on your way.
A plan you can actually follow: one change at a time, in the order that makes the next one easier.
Every other week, an hour to review, adjust and practise. Work between sessions is short and specific.
Every programme hits a crossing that feels too wide. This is where coaching earns its keep.
Twelve weeks on, the goal met and a map you can use on your own next time.

programmes.title: Three ways
programmes.sub: Every programme starts with a free call and ends with a plan you can keep using. Pay monthly or up front.

list.who: For people stepping into their first leadership role.
list.why: You have a new role and a short window to set the tone. A tight, practical programme fits.

list.who: For founders whose company has outgrown how they lead it.
list.why: You need room to rethink how you lead as the company grows. A longer programme gives you that.
